name: Ephemeral
source:
The main character, Chloe, lives in a town walled off with wire mesh, like a cage. Her city has been quarantined, and everyone inside, including her, is a zombie. Most of her friends chose to die young. Other than that, her everyday life is fairly peaceful, but Chloe wishes she could see more of the outside world. One day, she receives an invitation to attend a prestigious inter-species school for elite students. Together with a werewolf, an invisible boy, a vampire, and a mummy, she begins her new life at the academy. There she finds herself in a forbidden inter-species love…

[Translated from the official website]
translation:
主角克洛伊住在一个用铁丝网围起来的小镇里，就像一个笼子。她的城市已经被隔离，里面的每个人，包括她，都是僵尸。她的大多数朋友都选择英年早逝。除此之外，她的日常生活还算平静，但克洛伊希望她能多看看外面的世界。有一天，她收到一份邀请，前往一所为精英学生开设的著名跨物种学校。她与狼人、隐形男孩、吸血鬼、木乃伊一起，开始了学院的新生活。在那里，她发现自己陷入了一段禁忌的跨物种之爱……
